title: sign.rs: per-byte format!('{b:02x}') allocation in boundary_from_content
description: sign.rs:352 collects the hex string via .map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect(). Each format! call allocates a 2-char String. Idiomatic alternative: use write!(&mut hex, "{b:02x}") into a pre-allocated String::with_capacity(32), or use the hex crate (already available via der's transitive deps). The code is not on a hot path, but the pattern is the kind a contributor will copy into performance-sensitive code.
